outcome.technical: run-test-gate.py: pre_gate_stage(manifest, commands) reads meta.buildCommands.preGate through _manifest_vocab.pre_gate_command. It returns (name, command, problem), or no stage plus a printed line when the declared gate already names the key or the same resolved command. run_gate(pre_gate=...) runs the pre-gate as the first step, named _evidence_io.PRE_GATE_STEP ('pre-gate/preGate'), through the same per-step machinery. When pre_gate_stops(step) (an outcome, or a non-zero exit that is not muted), every later step is recorded by not_run_step: exit None, ran None, outcome could-not-run, outcomeBasis 'not run: the pre-gate (...) came back red (exit N), so the gate stopped before this step'; stoppedBy is kept in-process only. An unusable value becomes a leading could-not-run step whose basis is the plan's problem sentence; the full steps still run. main applies the stage only under --task without --own. The pre-gate is part of the reuse identity's commands, so a pre-gate that grades a left-out path is measured every run. It is published, so the row keeps its command verbatim and a base run can re-run it. part_reused_result puts it first. _render_steps prints a not-run line. _render_verdict leaves stoppedBy steps out of the GATE COULD NOT RUN banner. _evidence_io.py: PRE_GATE_STEP; declared_steps strips a LEADING PRE_GATE_STEP only. _manifest_phases.phase_gate_default leaves preGate out (always cannot put it back), returns it as preGate and names it in the basis. Tests: run-test-gate pre1-pre11 (new pgt-block), evidence pgs1-pgs2 (in _joined_step_cases), manifest phases pg15-pg16. Tallies: test_run_test_gate 770 cases, the three suites 1536 cases, full sweep 196/196 files, 20073 cases, exit 0. Mutations, each restored byte-identical with __pycache__ purged: M1 pre-gate green read as gate green -> pre3,pre4,pre5 red; M2 no stop -> pre1; M3 declared_steps keeps lead -> pgs1 (end to end pre5,pre11); M4 strip anywhere -> pgs2; M5 default keeps preGate -> pg15; M6 near-miss read as pre-gate -> pg16; M7 stage despite named entry -> pre7; M8 stage at phase scope -> pre8; M9 unusable skipped silently -> pre6; M10 stopped step under infra banner -> pre10; M11 stage with none declared -> pre9; M12 command not published -> pre2; M13 part reuse not leading -> pre11. Dependants: drive-phase still correct (read_back reads status; repeat_said/step_seconds handle a step without durationMs; base_need/base_unmeasured read _counts_as_failed steps, which are the pre-gate alone). _evidence_io row_is_red and named_failing_suites are correct (status is failed/could-not-run, never passed; not-run steps carry an outcome and so are not counted). _verdict_binding.gate_mismatch is correct through declared_steps (pre5). report/status/panel already render exit None (the panel shows '-') and show outcome plus basis. full-gate.py is unchanged: --full takes no stage and runs meta.fullGate once. audit-lookup and the other importers are unaffected (new names only). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md gains one paragraph in the run-test-gate.py section. changelog.d/P172.3.added.md added; changelog-check exit 0.
outcome.descriptive: A task's gate now runs the plan's pre-gate first. Its red stops the gate, and the steps it skipped are recorded by name as not run. A green pre-gate never stands in for the gate, an unusable value never reads green, and the pre-gate runs once.
